title: Paradox, AquaTerra's student fest in Kolkata · AquaTerra
description: Paradox, the student-run youth fest in Kolkata: from the online Dream Team Edition in 2022 to Paradox 3.0 in June 2025, and the welfare work its proceeds fund.
lede: Paradox is AquaTerra's student-run youth fest in Kolkata, with sport, business, creative and cultural events, and its proceeds fund the welfare drives. It began as an online mini fete in January 2022 and grew into a multi-day fest: Paradox 3.0 in June 2025 ran for five days with twelve events and a Punjabi Night. The fest has been held in early June, and the 2026 edition is listed for 1 to 6 June.

sections.heading: what paradox is
body: Paradox is AquaTerra's flagship fundraising series, as its own 2024 summary puts it. It is a student-run fest of sport, business, creative and cultural events in Kolkata, and its listing says the proceeds fund welfare. Across the Paradox editions and days on this page there have been {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and the largest team came for Paradox 3.0 in June 2025.

sections.heading: an online start and a mini fete
body: The first edition, the Dream Team Edition, ran online in January 2022 as a mini fete of fun, creativity and connection. Its own summary says it was powered by AquaTerra's youth, and it is the only Paradox on this page with an online venue.

The wind-down came in April 2022 at Gandhi Vidyalaya: a mini fete with games, snacks and giggles, all for a cause. It closed out Paradox 1.0, and it is also one of our school visits, so it appears on the [schools page](/impact/schools-we-have-visited) too.

sections.heading: food days under the paradox name
body: Two of the Paradox-named days are not fundraisers at all. Food Distribution Drive Day 1 on 29 December 2023 and Day 2 on 5 April 2024 both ran in Kolkata, handing out meals to people in need. Their own notes give 60 and 80 food packets donated per day.

The name carried over because the food days were run under Paradox, so a reader looking for the fest will also find meal drives. Both were small teams, and both are a useful reminder that the same brand can cover fundraising and direct help.

sections.heading: the june editions, 2024 and 2025
body: The Paradox fundraising event on 7 June 2024 used interactive and engaging activities to support AquaTerra's NGO initiatives, and it drew a large student team.

Paradox 3.0 followed on 2 June 2025. It ran for five days with twelve events and a Punjabi Night celebration, and its summary calls it AquaTerra's mega youth fundraiser. Its team was the largest of any Paradox on this page.

sections.heading: paradox 2026 and joining the team
body: The 2026 edition is listed for 1 to 6 June 2026, with the same mix of sport, business, creative and cultural events in Kolkata. Its listing says proceeds fund welfare, so it belongs with the other festive nights in [every night that paid for the work](/impact/the-nights-that-fund-the-work).

Students who want to run the next fest can [join AquaTerra](/join) and volunteer. Sport has its own page too: [sports fundraisers and TerraThon](/impact/sport-fundraisers) cover the matches and tournaments that sit alongside the fest.

learnings: A fest tied to a welfare cause, like Paradox, tells a reader where the money goes: its listing says the proceeds fund welfare.
Multi-day formats with many events give students more ways in: Paradox 3.0 ran for five days with twelve events.
The Paradox name also carried food days, so one brand can cover fundraising and direct meal drives.
Early June has been Paradox season, with the 2024 and 2025 editions and the 2026 listing all falling in early June.

faqs.a: Paradox is AquaTerra's student-run youth fest in Kolkata, with sport, business, creative and cultural events. Its proceeds fund AquaTerra's welfare drives, and the series began as an online mini fete in January 2022.
Paradox has been held in early June. The 2024 fundraising event was on 7 June, Paradox 3.0 ran for five days from 2 June 2025, and the 2026 edition is listed for 1 to 6 June.

faqs.q: Does Paradox pay for AquaTerra's welfare work?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra is self-funded and takes no donations, and Paradox is one of its student-run events whose proceeds fund the welfare drives.

faqs.q: How many volunteers have worked on Paradox?
faqs.a: Across Paradox and its food days, AquaTerra has counted {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and one student who came to more than one day is counted each time. Paradox 3.0 in June 2025 had the largest team.

faqs.q: How can students take part in Paradox?
faqs.a: Students can join AquaTerra and volunteer on the next Paradox team. Every drive AquaTerra runs is written up on its site, so you can see what the teams did.
